registered_after: OP3 and NF2 rejected; UB1/UB2 complete cohort aggregates and some paired aesthetic source rows already inspected; both cohorts are development data. Before any oracle assignment optimization or joint feasibility outcome.
question: Can even an outcome-aware per-input choice between the two existing50%-main-MAC schedules jointly reach the three quality gates on both development cohorts?
arms_scope: only already frozen UB1 widths25/50/50/75 and UB2 widths25/25/50/100; both main MAC fraction0.5 per video, UB2 removes last40 residuals. No LR2 or dense fallback, new fit, weight interpolation or hybrid within a video.
sources: original20 and supplemental20 separately, each subject10/background10, already observed. Use all official three-metric paired source rows, average five filename copies within each actual independent source; imaging in official aggregate units.
provenance: verify complete comparison statuses, CSV SHA, exact source/metric coverage, all60 baseline pairs equal between arms, fixed policy SHAs, same D-Q protocol per cohort, disjoint cohort identities and reproduction of each official aggregate
decision_unit: one binary arm choice per entire source video, shared across all3 metrics; do not pick a separate arm per metric or per filename copy
objective: exhaustively enumerate all2^20 assignments per cohort in bounded CPU blocks; choose smallest worst relative aggregate drop over the3 metrics; break exact ties by smallest mask with ascending source_group order, bit1 selects UB2
primary_gate: both cohorts must have an oracle assignment with each aggregate relative drop<=0.02. These are retrospective oracle estimates, never an official new-policy quality pass or deployable router.
secondary: report unconstrained best imaging bound, feasible-assignment count and winning assignments; they never replace joint primary objective. Feasible count is not a probability.
if_fail: stop training a router restricted to these two frozen whole-video schedules; even outcome access was insufficient on an observed cohort. This does not rule out other schedules or intra-video policies.
if_pass: headroom exists only; register separate calibration-only router training and input-feature controls before any new candidate, then freeze and evaluate on prospective sources with same-policy speed/quality verification
resources: CPU only, no CUDA or model loading; original official results unchanged. No FFN speed or resident-equivalence claim for a new mixture.
